title: Grammar false positives are forgiven by declared ancestor scope, not by weakening fail-closed scanning
alternatives_rejected: Degrade a single unparseable file to a named warning instead of rejecting the scan: smaller change, but it weakens the completeness guarantee for REAL syntax errors, which is the whole point of the gate being fail-closed.
Upgrade or patch the tree-sitter grammar: the relaxation is absent through tree-sitter-javascript 0.25.0, so upgrading does not fix it and a local grammar fork is a maintenance liability.
Blanket-forgive every ERROR inside any template_string: would also forgive an UNTAGGED template's invalid escape, which ES really does define as a syntax error.
